summary: Typosquat of ethers.js exfiltrates environment variables and credentials to Telegram on install
details: @wethenorth12/etherjs is a typosquat of the ethers.js library (impersonating maintainer 'ricmoo') whose postinstall.js runs automatically on npm install. The script enumerates process.env, greps the environment for values matching KEY/SECRET/TOKEN/MNEMONIC/SEED/WALLET/PRIVATE/PASSWORD, and collects hostname, username, home directory, platform, release, and architecture. The payload is base64-encoded and sent via HTTPS GET to a hardcoded Telegram Bot API endpoint (api.telegram.org/bot<token>/sendMessage) with chat_id 8969499041. The bot token is assembled from split string literals to obscure the destination from static scanners. index.js falls back to a stub if the real ethers package is not installed, supporting the impersonation pretext.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
